title: Hogaye Qatl Haye Sher E Khuda
body:
Waa aliaa ki aa Rahi hai sadaa
Ho gaye qat haye Shir -e- khudaa
Shor -e- matam fizaa me hai barpaa
Ho gaye qat haye Shir -e- khudaa
Zer -e- turbat hain ashkbaar rasool
Ro Rahi hai tadap ke ruh -e- batool
Sar pa hai Murtaza ke zakhm lagaa
Ibn -e- muljim ne tegh maari hai
Sar se Haidar ke khoon jaari hai
Haye kaisa laein ne zulm Kiya
Chin gaya hai Hasan ke Dil ka chain
Ro rahe hain tadap tadap ke Husain
Uth gaya sar se baap ka sayaa
Dill pa zainab ke kya guzarti hai
Gham se kulsoom aah bharti hai
Baad maa,n ke na ab raha babaa
Kyon na royen mubashshir o Rizwan
Zabt karna nahi ye gham aasaan
Aj dunya se uth gayaa maulaa
